faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Sangareddy District Court Stenographer Grade-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Stenographer Grade-III post is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 34 years for all candidates applying for the Stenographer Grade-III position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Stenographer Grade-III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Graduates from any recognized university and possess Shorthand and Typewriting skills in English at Lower or Higher levels.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Stenographer Grade-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 22,750/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Stenographer Grade-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Stenographer Grade-III post in the Sangareddy District Court.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Stenographer Grade-III recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Stenographer Grade-III role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Stenographer Grade-III post primarily involves Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Sangareddy District Court.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Sangareddy District Court, which is https://sangareddy.dcourts.gov.in.
